title: I made a million dollar product from my dorm room (2025)
summary: An indie maker shares how they built a profitable product (Nice Nano, a mechanical keyboard project) from their college dorm room, documenting the journey from idea to revenue. The post likely covers product development, marketing strategies, and lessons learned from starting a business while being a student.
problem_solved: Demonstrates how a college student can launch and monetize a physical product business with minimal resources and capital.
why_valuable: Provides real-world insights and practical tactics for aspiring indie hackers, showing that you don't need a team or venture capital to build a successful product.
